# Kinetix

> Kinetix is a product studio for apps, websites and AI systems, based in
> Kuwait. We design and build iOS and Android apps, multilingual websites and
> online stores, AI systems such as WhatsApp AI agents, and brand identities
> for established businesses in Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and the GCC. Projects
> from 750 KD. Every project gets a fixed quote after a short call.

- **Website:** https://www.kinetixkw.com
- **Arabic:** https://www.kinetixkw.com/ar/
- **Location:** Kuwait City, Kuwait, serving Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and the GCC
- **Languages:** Arabic, English
- **Start a project:** https://www.kinetixkw.com/start
- **Freelancers:** https://www.kinetixkw.com/join
- **Instagram:** @kinetixkw

## What we build
- [Apps, websites and stores](https://www.kinetixkw.com/services/web-development.html): iOS and Android apps, from first version to launch. Websites and online stores in Arabic, English and more, with KNET and card payments, booking and real tracking.
- [AI systems](https://www.kinetixkw.com/services/ai-automation.html): WhatsApp AI agents that answer in Arabic and English, qualify inquiries and book appointments, plus automations that take repetitive work off a team.
- [Brand identity](https://www.kinetixkw.com/services/brand-identity.html): Logo, bilingual Arabic and English type, color and guidelines, built to carry into the website and app.

## Pricing
- Projects start from 750 KD.
- Every project gets a fixed quote after a short call: https://www.kinetixkw.com/start

## Proof
- Al Jadad: a course platform and app for a 124K-follower psychologist.
